name: Free Membership
description: Create your profile, browse members and send interests, at no cost.

benefits.title: View Other Profiles
benefits.detail: View other members' profiles and the basic details their privacy settings allow.

benefits.title: Send and Receive Interests
benefits.detail: Send up to 15 expressions of interest in total, and receive interests from other members.

benefits.title: Mobile Number Verification
benefits.detail: Mobile number verification by OTP, where the verification flow applies.

benefits.title: Basic Privacy and Contact Protection
benefits.detail: Your mobile number is never shown to free members, and only to paid members if you choose to share it.

benefits.title: Profile Review
benefits.detail: Your profile is reviewed by the Massil team before other members can see it, according to company policy.

terms.title: Free Membership Terms
terms.body: Free membership has no fee. It includes up to 15 outgoing interests in total. Other members' mobile numbers are not visible on free membership: contact-number access needs an eligible paid membership and the other member's consent. What other members see of your profile depends on your privacy settings.

name: Silver Membership
description: A three-month online membership with advanced search, unlimited interests and access to member contact numbers.

benefits.title: Verified Profile Badge for eligible profiles
Access to up to 40 member contact numbers during the three-month membership period, subject to applicable privacy settings, member consent, and company terms

terms.title: Validity Terms
terms.body: The Silver Membership is valid for three months from the activation date. Benefits and contact access are subject to Maasil Matrimony.com's published terms and privacy policy.

name: Gold Membership
description: A six-month online membership with wider contact access, priority visibility and matchmaking assistance.

benefits.title: Verified Profile Badge for eligible profiles
Priority Profile Visibility, subject to platform availability
Dedicated Matchmaking Assistance, subject to service availability
Access to up to 100 member contact numbers during the six-month membership period, subject to applicable privacy settings, member consent, and company terms

terms.title: Validity Terms
terms.body: The Gold Membership is valid for six months from the activation date. Benefits and contact access are subject to Maasil Matrimony.com's published terms and privacy policy.

name: Diamond Membership
description: An enhanced online membership for members who want additional profile discovery and communication features.

benefits.title: Verified Profile Badge for eligible profiles
Priority Profile Visibility, subject to platform availability
Dedicated Matchmaking Assistance, subject to service availability
Access to up to 100 member contact numbers during the membership period, subject to applicable privacy settings, member consent, and company terms

terms.title: Validity Terms
terms.body: The Diamond Membership is valid for twelve months from the activation date. Benefits and contact access are subject to Maasil Matrimony.com's published terms and privacy policy.

name: Platinum
subtitle: Assisted Matchmaking
description: Personalised, staff-assisted matchmaking for members seeking dedicated guidance during their search.

benefits.title: Free Online Registration
benefits.detail: Members receive free online registration and a personal member ID to access their profile and available platform features.

benefits.title: Dedicated Matchmaker
benefits.detail: A designated Massil matchmaking staff member assists the member throughout the service period.

benefits.title: Personalised Profile Search
benefits.detail: The matchmaker understands the member's preferences, searches for suitable profiles, and assists with shortlisting potential matches.

benefits.title: Interest Management
benefits.detail: Members can express interest through their online account. The matchmaker assists in coordinating mutual interest and follow-up.

benefits.title: Contact & Communication Coordination
benefits.detail: The assigned matchmaker coordinates contact exchange and communication with prospective matches and families, subject to consent and privacy requirements.

benefits.title: Follow-up Assistance
benefits.detail: The matchmaker assists with follow-ups and coordinates further discussions when both parties are interested.

benefits.title: Privacy & Confidentiality
benefits.detail: Member information is handled in accordance with Maasil Matrimony.com's privacy policy. Contact details are shared only with appropriate consent.

terms.title: Service Terms
terms.body: The package is valid for three months from the activation date. The scope of staff assistance, service hours, profile shortlisting, and communication arrangements will be specified in the Platinum service agreement.

name: Royal
subtitle: Exclusive At-Home Matchmaking
description: An exclusive, high-touch matchmaking service designed for busy professionals, entrepreneurs, business leaders, and families seeking a discreet, personalised experience.

benefits.title: Exclusive Personalised Service
benefits.detail: Massil Royal is an exclusive, high-touch matchmaking service designed for busy professionals, business leaders, entrepreneurs, celebrities, and families seeking a discreet and personalised matchmaking experience.

benefits.title: At-Home Matchmaking
benefits.detail: A designated Massil matchmaking representative visits the member's residence at mutually agreed, convenient times to understand their preferences and present carefully shortlisted matrimonial profiles.

benefits.title: Personalised Profile Curation
benefits.detail: The Massil team identifies potential matches based on the member's preferences, family expectations, and agreed selection criteria. Members are not required to independently search through profiles online.

benefits.title: Dedicated Matchmaker
benefits.detail: A designated matchmaking representative coordinates profile selection, expressions of interest, communication, and follow-up throughout the service period.

benefits.title: Family Coordination
benefits.detail: With the consent of both parties, Massil assists in coordinating introductions, family discussions, and subsequent meetings.

benefits.title: Privacy & Confidentiality
benefits.detail: Member information, preferences, and family details are handled confidentially under the company's privacy policy. Profiles and contact details are shared only with appropriate permission.

terms.title: Annual Service Validity
terms.body: The Royal package is valid for twelve months from the activation date. Home visits, service hours, travel arrangements, the number of shortlisted profiles, and other service limits will be specified in the signed service agreement.
